name: Armory
author: Clicktrough (characters: NC's AION 2 character pages; enhance tables and items: the game's files via Aion2Data; prices: aion2.exchange)
description: Your character as NC's character pages show it, every value written out: gear with enhance, Amplify, Manastones and Theostones, stats, skills, Daevanion boards, titles. The gear score from its parts, where each skill's level comes from and what is left to 20, a reference build (a saved questlog.gg page) to compare with, the cheapest enhancing to a target gear score or combat power with its cost in Kinah and materials, and the history of every reading.
